# 3 is "empty", 0 is "solid"
# Find all 3s reachable from edge via 3s

    if empty[r][cols-1]:

            empty[r][c] = 0

# Flood fill from boundary of pattern region
visited = [[False]*pat_cols for _ in range(pat_rows)]
queue = deque()

# Add boundary 3s to queue
for r in range(pat_rows):
    if empty[r][0]:  # Left boundary
        queue.append((r, 0))
        visited[r][0] = True
    if empty[r][pat_cols-1]:  # Right boundary
